assumptions.batteries: five equivalent Bideal batteries; not five physical batteries at merely equal displayed percentages
assumptions.position_assignment: identity retained; permutations are time-equivalent under equal SOC and identical charging assumptions
assumptions.charging_pads: 1..5 identical pads, all available on arrival, one drone per pad at a time, non-preemptive charging
assumptions.charging_completion: minimum time until every drone has completed charging; do not sum individual waiting times again
assumptions.ground_wait: no battery drain while waiting on the ground
assumptions.switching: not included; configuration is chosen before this segment
assumptions.objective: single standardized flight segment + subsequent whole-swarm charging completion; not a global multi-segment optimum
assumptions.evidence: unchanged equal-run mean Medium discharge rates; source short, partial, flat, and low-count warnings retained; no new filters
assumptions.source_coverage: observed real forward-flight candidates only; no simulated or invented missing configurations
assumptions.total_time: computed from empirical discharge rates and an assumed charging model, not directly measured total mission time
